Sculpting in Blender 5.2 for organic models, characters, creatures, rocks and bake sources: the base-to-detail workflow, voxel remesh, dynamic topology and multires, the 5.x brush types, masks and face sets, symmetry, and headless-safe procedural operations an agent can run (remesh, symmetrize, multires, inflate, noise detail, smoothing), plus the sculpt-to-game handoff.
